target.name: readmitted_30d
target.definition: 1 if raw 'readmitted' == '<30' (readmitted within 30 days); 0 if '>30' or 'NO'.

feature_descriptions.time_in_hospital: Length of the index stay in days.
feature_descriptions.num_lab_procedures: Number of lab tests performed during the encounter.
feature_descriptions.num_procedures: Number of non-lab procedures during the encounter.
feature_descriptions.num_medications: Number of distinct generic medications administered.
feature_descriptions.number_outpatient: Outpatient visits in the year before the encounter.
feature_descriptions.number_emergency: Emergency visits in the year before the encounter.
feature_descriptions.number_inpatient: Inpatient admissions in the year before the encounter.
feature_descriptions.number_diagnoses: Number of diagnoses entered for the encounter.
feature_descriptions.age_years: Midpoint of the 10-year age bracket (ordinal age).
feature_descriptions.total_prior_visits: Engineered: outpatient + emergency + inpatient visits in the prior year.
feature_descriptions.any_prior_inpatient: Engineered: 1 if any inpatient admission in the prior year.
feature_descriptions.meds_per_day: Engineered medication burden: medications / length of stay.
feature_descriptions.n_diabetes_meds: Engineered: count of diabetes medications prescribed (not 'No').
feature_descriptions.n_med_dose_changes: Engineered: count of diabetes medications with dose Up/Down.
feature_descriptions.on_diabetes_med: Engineered: 1 if any diabetes medication was prescribed.
feature_descriptions.a1c_tested: Engineered: 1 if an HbA1c test was performed.
feature_descriptions.glucose_tested: Engineered: 1 if a max glucose serum test was performed.
feature_descriptions.discharge_disposition: Where the patient was discharged to.
feature_descriptions.admission_source: Where the patient was admitted from.
feature_descriptions.medical_specialty: Specialty of the admitting physician (rare values grouped).
feature_descriptions.diag_1_group: Engineered: ICD-9 chapter group of the primary diagnosis.
feature_descriptions.diag_2_group: Engineered: ICD-9 chapter group of the secondary diagnosis.
feature_descriptions.diag_3_group: Engineered: ICD-9 chapter group of the additional diagnosis.
feature_descriptions.max_glu_serum: Max glucose serum test result category.
feature_descriptions.change: Whether any diabetes medication was changed.

excluded_columns.readmitted: Original outcome column (the target itself) - direct leakage.
excluded_columns.encounter_id: Row identifier; carries no clinical signal and may encode time order.
excluded_columns.patient_nbr: Patient identifier; used ONLY as the grouping key for patient-aware splits.
excluded_columns.payer_code: ~40% missing administrative/insurance field; a socioeconomic proxy that adds fairness risk without being a clinical factor at discharge.
excluded_columns.race: Sensitive attribute. Excluded from model inputs to avoid encoding demographic bias; retained only for subgroup (fairness) evaluation.
excluded_columns.examide: Constant column (single value in the entire dataset).
excluded_columns.citoglipton: Constant column (single value in the entire dataset).
